messages:
sara: Quick recap from today's POC sync with Pulsar — they want a drop-in replacement for CompetitorX. Main asks: minimize output drift, match token invoicing during the 90-day trial, and a straight mapping for their existing SDK calls. Posting notes and owners.

kay: Tech note: their SDK calls use `role` fields as `actor: system|user|assistant` and include a `metadata.trace_id`. We should map to our `messages` array and preserve trace_id via headers. Sample shim I sketched: 
```http
POST /v1/adapter/infer
Content-Type: application/json
X-Trace-Id: {{metadata.trace_id}}
{
  "conversation": [ {"actor":"system","text":"..."}, {"actor":"user","text":"..."} ]
}
```
Map to Redwood: `messages: [{role:system, content:...}, {role:user, content:...}]` and forward X-Trace-Id as `x-request-id`.

mike: Billing: CompetitorX does pre-tokenization normalization (collapsing repeated newlines and trimming trailing space) which reduces counts slightly. For the POC we can do two options: 1) adapter normalizes identically so on-token counts match, or 2) we bill their observed usage but provide an upfront credit to offset the delta. Which does sales prefer?

juan: Ops concern: CompetitorX streams micro-deltas (~50 bytes) which client expects to stitch. Our default stream emits larger frames. We have a `stream_chunk_hint` parameter to emit smaller chunks; add `bufflush=true` on the adapter layer to emulate their behavior. Also note: KV-cache cold starts caused 200-300ms extra latency on yesterday's run — recommend prewarm for session-heavy tests.

kay: Security inbound: Pulsar submitted the enterprise questionnaire and flagged three blockers: customer-managed KMS for Dedicated, IP allowlist for control plane, and SAML SSO provisioning via SCIM. I can draft the security response doc but need details on retention APIs and redaction.

sara: They also asked about PII handling — they said they will not intentionally log SSNs but free-form chat will contain names/emails. For the POC they requested logs retained 30 days and accessible for debugging; retrieval must be audited. @juan can we provide a deletion API and event that shows deletion?

juan: Yes — we expose `DELETE /v1/logs/{session_id}` which returns a deletion receipt with a signed timestamp. For Dedicated we can scope log retention policies per tenant. Example SOW snippet to confirm.

mike: Pricing follow-up from buyer: "Can Redwood invoice us at a fixed per-1k-token rate for the 90-day POC even if our internal counts differ?" They want predictability.

kay: Legal wants the temporary pricing in writing and a reconciliation clause. Suggested clause: if cumulative delta > 7% over POC, either party can request reconciliation and Redwood will credit the difference beyond 7% once validated. Also add an explicit no-commit beyond trial unless contract signed.

sara: Sales proposal I'm drafting: (1) 90-day POC with fixed POC rate $X per 1k tokens, (2) adapter normalization to mirror competitor tokenizer for the trial, (3) 30-day log retention + deletion API, (4) SOC2 attestation + KMS support on Dedicated. Will include the reconciliation clause.

ci-bot: ci-bot: artifact uploaded -> /pulsar_poc/shim_v1.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

juan: Action items: 
- kay: finalize security answers and attach the redaction/deletion flow (EOD today)
- mike: prepare sample harness that runs 500 representative prompts and emits side-by-side responses + token counts (demo Wed)
- sara: draft the POC email + SOW template and include pricing clause (tomorrow morning)
- devops: enable `bufflush=true` flag in staging shim for the demo (juan to coordinate)

kay: I'll include the SCIM setup steps for SSO and a note that Dedicated supports customer KMS (HSM-backed) and IP allowlisting for control plane. Will attach the filled questionnaire to this thread.

mike: For the harness, I'll add both tokenizers so we can show a delta report and a sample normalization patch. Example normalizer snippet: 
```python
import re
def compx_normalize(text):
    text = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", text)
    text = text.rstrip()
    return text
```
This should align counts in most cases.

sara: Great. I'll cc legal and solutions engineering on the outbound email. Scheduling follow-up Friday 10am PT to review harness results.

juan: One last note: document the fallback model policy in the SOW — if a model variant is used for cost reasons, we need a notice window so buyer can validate behavior. Add that to the draft.

sara: Thanks all — sending initial email after I get Kay's security answers.
